lines.text: Starfish is rebuilt for phone GPUs: faster 100% zoom, balanced tiles, and zero register-spill freezes.
UI gestures, dial drags, and tool-dial turns stay smooth while Starfish loads or prepares in the background.
Ultra 4× exports now run one pass at a time so your phone stays responsive and Cancel answers right away.
Fixed shadow-noise bleed in Starfish and Clarity fine-detail masks so clean shadows stay clean at every ISO.
